name: EVE
canonical: Eve, the first woman, a graceful slender young figure with warm golden-brown skin and long flowing chestnut-dark hair falling about her shoulders, a fair sorrowful face turned away in shame, her bare body covered only by a soft girdle of sewn fig leaves, crouching close beside Adam amid the verdant trees of Eden
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
